requirements.quote: BGP implementations MUST recognize all well-known attributes.
requirements.condition: When processing BGP path attributes.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST recognize all well-known attributes.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute dispatch can be checked for recognition of every well-known attribute.

requirements.quote:
Some
   of these attributes are mandatory and MUST be included in every
   UPDATE message that contains NLRI.
requirements.condition: An UPDATE message contains NLRI.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST include every well-known mandatory attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: Generated UPDATE messages with NLRI can be inspected for mandatory attribute presence.

requirements.quote:
Others are discretionary and MAY
   or MAY NOT be sent in a particular UPDATE message.
requirements.condition: A well-known attribute is discretionary.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY include or omit the discretionary attribute in a particular UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: Presence and absence can be checked as permitted forms for discretionary attributes.

requirements.quote:
Once a BGP peer has updated any well-known attributes, it MUST pass
   these attributes to its peers in any updates it transmits.
requirements.condition: A BGP peer has updated well-known attributes and transmits an update for the path.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST pass the updated well-known attributes to its peers in the transmitted updates.
requirements.why_checkable: Outbound attributes can be compared with the updated attributes stored for the path.

requirements.quote:
In addition to well-known attributes, each path MAY contain one or
   more optional attributes.  It is not required or expected that all
   BGP implementations support all optional attributes.
requirements.condition: A path has optional attributes.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY contain one or more optional attributes; support for every optional attribute is not required.
requirements.why_checkable: Optional attribute handling can allow multiple optional attributes without requiring universal implementation support.

requirements.quote:
The handling of
   an unrecognized optional attribute is determined by the setting of
   the Transitive bit in the attribute flags octet.
requirements.condition: An optional attribute is unrecognized.
requirements.required_behavior: Determine handling using the Transitive bit in the attribute flags octet.
requirements.why_checkable: The unknown-attribute handling branch can be checked for use of the Transitive flag.

requirements.quote:
Paths with
   unrecognized transitive optional attributes SHOULD be accepted.
requirements.condition: A path contains an unrecognized transitive optional attribute.
requirements.required_behavior: SHOULD accept the path.
requirements.why_checkable: An otherwise acceptable path with an unknown transitive optional attribute can be submitted and its acceptance observed.

requirements.quote:
If a
   path with an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted
   and passed to other BGP peers, then the unrecognized transitive
   optional attribute of that path MUST be passed, along with the path,
   to other BGP peers with the Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet
   set to 1.
requirements.condition: A path containing an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed to other BGP peers.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST pass that unrecognized transitive optional attribute with the path to other BGP peers.
requirements.why_checkable: The outgoing path can be checked for preservation of an unknown transitive optional attribute.

requirements.quote:
If a
   path with an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted
   and passed to other BGP peers, then the unrecognized transitive
   optional attribute of that path MUST be passed, along with the path,
   to other BGP peers with the Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet
   set to 1.
requirements.condition: A path containing an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed to other BGP peers.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the Partial bit of the forwarded unrecognized transitive optional attribute to 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The forwarded attribute flags can be decoded and its Partial bit inspected.

requirements.quote:
If a path with a recognized, transitive optional attribute
   is accepted and passed along to other BGP peers and the Partial bit
   in the Attribute Flags octet is set to 1 by some previous AS, it MUST
   NOT be set back to 0 by the current AS.
requirements.condition: A path with a recognized transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed to peers, and a previous AS set its Partial bit to 1.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: MUST NOT set that Partial bit back to 0 in the current AS.
requirements.why_checkable: An accepted recognized attribute with Partial=1 can be forwarded and checked for flag preservation.

requirements.quote:
Unrecognized non-transitive
   optional attributes MUST be quietly ignored and not passed along to
   other BGP peers.
requirements.condition: An optional non-transitive attribute is unrecognized.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST quietly ignore the attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: Unknown non-transitive attribute input can be checked for silent discard.

requirements.quote:
Unrecognized non-transitive
   optional attributes MUST be quietly ignored and not passed along to
   other BGP peers.
requirements.condition: An optional non-transitive attribute is unrecognized.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: MUST NOT pass the attribute along to other BGP peers.
requirements.why_checkable: Outgoing UPDATE messages can be checked for absence of the unknown non-transitive attribute.

requirements.quote:
New, transitive optional attributes MAY be attached to the path by
   the originator or by any other BGP speaker in the path.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker is the path originator or another speaker in the path.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY attach new transitive optional attributes to the path.
requirements.why_checkable: Path attribute insertion can be checked as permitted at the originator and at intermediate speakers.

requirements.quote:
New, transitive optional attributes MAY be attached to the path by
   the originator or by any other BGP speaker in the path.  If they are
   not attached by the originator, the Partial bit in the Attribute
   Flags octet is set to 1.
requirements.condition: A new transitive optional attribute is attached by a BGP speaker other than the originator.
requirements.required_behavior: Set its Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet to 1.
requirements.why_checkable: An intermediate speaker adding a new attribute can be checked for Partial=1.

requirements.quote:
All optional
   attributes (both transitive and non-transitive), MAY be updated (if
   appropriate) by BGP speakers in the path.
requirements.condition: Updating an optional attribute is appropriate for that attribute and path.
requirements.required_behavior: BGP speakers in the path MAY update optional attributes, both transitive and non-transitive.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute update logic can be inspected for permission to modify either optional category; attribute-specific appropriateness remains a condition.

requirements.quote:
The sender of an UPDATE message SHOULD order path attributes within
   the UPDATE message in ascending order of attribute type.
requirements.condition: Sending an UPDATE message.
requirements.required_behavior: SHOULD order path attributes in ascending order of attribute type.
requirements.why_checkable: The sequence of type codes in a generated UPDATE can be compared with ascending order.

requirements.quote:
The
   receiver of an UPDATE message MUST be prepared to handle path
   attributes within UPDATE messages that are out of order.
requirements.condition: Receiving an UPDATE whose path attributes are out of order.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST be prepared to handle the out-of-order path attributes.
requirements.why_checkable: A valid UPDATE with permuted attribute order can be processed to check order-independent handling.

requirements.quote:
The same attribute (attribute with the same type) cannot appear more
   than once within the Path Attributes field of a particular UPDATE
   message.
requirements.condition: Within the Path Attributes field of one UPDATE message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The same attribute type cannot appear more than once.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute type occurrences can be counted and duplicate types detected.

requirements.quote:
The mandatory category refers to an attribute that MUST be present in
   both IBGP and EBGP exchanges if NLRI are contained in the UPDATE
   message.
requirements.condition: An IBGP or EBGP UPDATE message contains NLRI.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST include attributes in the mandatory category in both IBGP and EBGP exchanges.
requirements.why_checkable: Mandatory attribute presence can be checked separately for internal and external peer UPDATEs.

requirements.quote:
The mandatory category refers to an attribute that MUST be present in
   both IBGP and EBGP exchanges if NLRI are contained in the UPDATE
   message.  Attributes classified as optional for the purpose of the
   protocol extension mechanism may be purely discretionary,
   discretionary, required, or disallowed in certain contexts.

        attribute           EBGP                    IBGP
         ORIGIN             mandatory               mandatory
requirements.condition: An IBGP or EBGP UPDATE message contains NLRI.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST include the ORIGIN attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The NLRI presence condition and mandatory table entry identify a directly checkable attribute-presence requirement.

requirements.quote:
The mandatory category refers to an attribute that MUST be present in
   both IBGP and EBGP exchanges if NLRI are contained in the UPDATE
   message.  Attributes classified as optional for the purpose of the
   protocol extension mechanism may be purely discretionary,
   discretionary, required, or disallowed in certain contexts.

        attribute           EBGP                    IBGP
         ORIGIN             mandatory               mandatory
         AS_PATH            mandatory               mandatory
requirements.condition: An IBGP or EBGP UPDATE message contains NLRI.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST include the AS_PATH attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The NLRI presence condition and mandatory table entry identify a directly checkable attribute-presence requirement.

requirements.quote:
The mandatory category refers to an attribute that MUST be present in
   both IBGP and EBGP exchanges if NLRI are contained in the UPDATE
   message.  Attributes classified as optional for the purpose of the
   protocol extension mechanism may be purely discretionary,
   discretionary, required, or disallowed in certain contexts.

        attribute           EBGP                    IBGP
         ORIGIN             mandatory               mandatory
         AS_PATH            mandatory               mandatory
         NEXT_HOP           mandatory               mandatory
requirements.condition: An IBGP or EBGP UPDATE message contains NLRI.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST include the NEXT_HOP attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The NLRI presence condition and mandatory table entry identify a directly checkable attribute-presence requirement.

requirements.quote:
attribute           EBGP                    IBGP
         ORIGIN             mandatory               mandatory
         AS_PATH            mandatory               mandatory
         NEXT_HOP           mandatory               mandatory
         MULTI_EXIT_DISC    discretionary           discretionary
requirements.condition: An UPDATE is exchanged over EBGP or IBGP.
requirements.required_behavior: MULTI_EXIT_DISC is discretionary and may be included or omitted.
requirements.why_checkable: The attribute-presence policy can be checked for both peer types.

requirements.quote:
attribute           EBGP                    IBGP
         ORIGIN             mandatory               mandatory
         AS_PATH            mandatory               mandatory
         NEXT_HOP           mandatory               mandatory
         MULTI_EXIT_DISC    discretionary           discretionary
         LOCAL_PREF         see Section 5.1.5       required
requirements.condition: An UPDATE carrying path attributes is exchanged over IBGP.
requirements.required_behavior: Include the required LOCAL_PREF attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The IBGP attribute set can be inspected for LOCAL_PREF presence.

requirements.quote:
attribute           EBGP                    IBGP
         ORIGIN             mandatory               mandatory
         AS_PATH            mandatory               mandatory
         NEXT_HOP           mandatory               mandatory
         MULTI_EXIT_DISC    discretionary           discretionary
         LOCAL_PREF         see Section 5.1.5       required
         ATOMIC_AGGREGATE   see Section 5.1.6 and 9.1.4
         AGGREGATOR         discretionary           discretionary
requirements.condition: An UPDATE is exchanged over EBGP or IBGP.
requirements.required_behavior: AGGREGATOR is discretionary and may be included or omitted.
requirements.why_checkable: The attribute-presence policy can be checked for both peer types.
